verdict: Three storyboard panels in one loose ink-and-wash style, each held exactly as long as Kokoro takes to read its line, cut into a 15-second animatic. The timing works. The character doesn't hold: the robot is a different design in each panel, because each panel is drawn from words alone with no reference. Panel 1 also came out as three frames in one. No person has listened to the narration for this review.
peak_note: Peak is this run's own ComfyUI and tools, read from nvidia-smi every 2 seconds. The card was shared with other work. Time adds up each stage's own work, not the wait for the shared card.

values.n1: On the roof of the tallest building, a small robot gardener wakes up with the sun.
values.n2: It waters every pot in a long row, one careful drop at a time.
values.n3: When the last flower opens, it sits down and watches the city wake.
